messages:
maya_s: quick note — after converting Llama3->GemmaX weights I'm seeing small but consistent token drift in >8k context runs. samples diverge around step 11.
srinivas_p: can you paste the conversion cmd + a tiny repro?
maya_s: sure:
```
python convert_weights.py --from-arch llama3 --to-arch gemmax --transpose-qk --fix-rotary
python eval_longcontext.py --model out/gemmax --input tests/long_repeat.txt --max-tokens 9000
```
output snippet:
```
step 10: token=the, logp=-1.23
step 11: token=cat, logp=-2.01
step 12: token=<unk>, logp=-9.87  # unexpected
```
srinivas_p: hmm. that <unk> jump smells like tokenizer id collision or embedding projection mismatch.
oliver_k: did the conversion flip the q/k projection order? Gemma forks sometimes use (k,q) memory layout in the serialized weights.
maya_s: checked shapes: q_proj (4096,4096) k_proj (4096,4096) but the byte-order changed during freeze. quick diff shows many transposes.
oliver_k: try this quick check — run forward with raw float32 weights and compare kv cache ids:
```
# snippet
out_f = model_f32(step_prefix)
out_q = model_int8(step_prefix)
assert out_f.kv_cache.shape == out_q.kv_cache.shape
np.testing.assert_allclose(out_f.kv_cache[:,11,:], out_q.kv_cache[:,11,:], atol=1e-3)
```
maya_s: ran that. got mismatch at head 3, token 11. dump:
```
kvcache_mismatch head=3 idx=11 mean_diff=0.0129
```
eval-bot: quick-bench summary — float32 vs int4-ptq: 8k context perplexity delta +0.9 on long_repeat, mismatch onset ~11 tokens.
depp: (typo) meant deepa
debbie_r: did you also check rotary frequency config? if q/k got swapped, rotary scaling per-head could apply wrong dims.
srinivas_p: good call. check model.config and rotary_freq table. also tokenizer special tokens — some conversions preserve unk vs pad id differently.
maya_s: found it — tokenizer config had pad_token_id == unk_token_id (4095) after merge. Fixing tokenizer mapping and re-running conversion made mismatch disappear.
oliver_k: nice. follow-ups: add a conversion sanity-check that asserts pad != unk and verifies q/k transpose via a fingerprint hash.
maya_s: filed PR to convert script with asserts + small test. will run quantization bench after.
debbie_r: :thumbsup:
maya_s: will post results in a new thread once int4 smoke runs finish.
